I absolutely love Pan’s Mushrooms! I purchased the variety pack, and every flavor was delicious. My only complaint is that the bags seem to disappear way too quickly before I know it, I've finished a whole pack! Even the limited-edition flavors are just as amazing. My one suggestion would be to offer larger bag sizes for those of us who can't get enough. Thank you for creating such a delicious, high quality snack and for continuing to come up with amazing flavors. Keep up the great work! 🍄❤️
